title: cymopterus humilis
intro: Cymopterus humilis, commonly known as Western desert patchouli, is a perennial herb native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, that may aid in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, respiratory issues, and gastrointestinal problems. The therapeutic actions of Western desert patchouli include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and ease respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of Cymopterus humilis include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
